category.title: Category
category.description: Optional governed Headroom category to limit to, e.g. Core Program, Trees.

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional country to narrow the ranking.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2029. Defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: What to rank by: largest funding gap / most headroom (default, forecast headroom), over-allocated (most over-funded), or secured headroom.

topN.title: Top N
topN.description: How many program groups to return; default 8. Pass the user's requested limit (e.g. top 3) when they give one.
